title: Fix the #include
prompt:
Ciel glares at your screen. Your Hello World doesn't even compile.

std::cout prints to the console, but it lives in a header file you have to include first. Fix the program so it prints exactly:

Hello, world!
hints: Read the compiler error. It's telling you std::cout hasn't been declared, because its header isn't included.
Add this as the very first line: #include <iostream>
